scope: Independent review of the three parent-authored fourth-fiber and signed-facet-pairing modules at successful checkpoint 4.

findings.details: The existing genuine cubic normal fibers are multiplied by the actual endpoint radius lower bound R(output)>=R(base)/2. Compact-domain continuity supplies integrability for monotonicity of the actual fourth-weight Gaussian integrals. Constants are exact: facet base cubic factor 1/64 and ridge base squared-radius chord factor 1/4096. Positivity of the kernel and R>=1 justifies each comparison. The ridge displacement norm bound is the actual rectangular-fiber one; no inverse Gram or minimum-gap constant is introduced.

The paired signed conormal coefficient is bounded before dividing by angular scales, using its genuine cancellation bound 2*chord*norm(z)^2. The hypothesis norm(z)<=R(base) controls both orthonormal frame coordinates and yields the exact 8192*exp(3/2) ridge-fiber multiplier. The scalar weighted facet bound |b|*|b^2-1|<=2R^3 follows from R>=1 and |b|<=R. Combining with the actual facet fiber gives exact 128*exp(3/2). No final surface localization bound is assumed.

The finite off-diagonal sum is reduced to the full sum minus its diagonal; transpose equality follows from finite-sum commutation and gives the exact factor 1/2 in pairing. The actual hard-facet Green formula is substituted before taking absolute values. Both oriented numerators and their shared density are paired with rho symmetry. Although an intermediate theorem accepts ordinary density symmetry, the public of_slack endpoint explicitly discharges it using the checked actual two-normal ridge identity. The AE endpoint uses the already proved simultaneous ordinary residual-slack full-measure set.

qualifications: The fiber estimates are concrete local Gaussian integral comparisons; their aggregation over hard facets/ridges and concentrated-base localization remain separate work.
The signed pairing is exact at residual-regular thresholds and volume-almost everywhere; no all-threshold quantitative H.1 certification is claimed.
Only final successful checkpoint 4 is reviewed; the preserved failed checkpoint 3 is not relabeled or overwritten.
